stem: What is the most likely reason the man in France agreed to give Bessie flying lessons?

options.label: F
options.text: He was impressed that she had come such a long way to learn to be a pilot.

options.label: G
options.text: He hoped that she could help him with his work at the hangar.

options.label: H
options.text: He knew that she had read many books about becoming a pilot.

options.label: J
options.text: He thought that she might be able to help him learn English in return.
